consentNote: I CONSENT with zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX, and I record this as the SATISFIED-GRADE review D-056 gate 4 requires, with all five gates certified above. Across three turns the entry took one MUST-FIX and two SHOULD-FIX and repaired each in the form asked. The one that matters most at this turn is the re-pin: a byte-exact replacement specification whose baseline digest has moved is a specification against bytes that no longer exist, and rather than accept the new pins because they look current I re-ran every anchor against the live register — five present, each exactly once. This cycle also corrected me: I cleared the Blueprint-impact hard-blocker at turn 1 and it was the second execution-based bar gate 5 required displacing, which I recorded as a self-correction at turn 2 and verified independently rather than deferring. And one certification here is weaker than the rest: I declined to open the contract's own independent verdict, so the advisories-are-not-reservations finding rests on D-015's adopted record and the live cell. That is the seam a later reviewer should press if this SATISFIED is ever questioned.
